item.title: SWAH emergency surgery decisions sits with Western Trust, says Nesbitt
item.description: Health minister Mike Nesbitt has stopped short of committing to restoring emergency surgical services at the South West Acute Hospital (SWAH), saying decisions about staffing and service configuration rest primarily with the Western Health and Social Care...

item.title: Funding arrangements for special education school outlined by Givan
item.description: The funding arrangements for places at the Buddy Bear Trust Conductive Education School in Dungannon have been set out by the education minister, following questions about how the specialist provision is supported within Northern Ireland’s special educational needs...

item.title: Fermanagh retailer reports success after adopting new AI tool
item.description: A Fermanagh retailer is reporting early success after adopting a new artificial intelligence tool.

item.title: Alison Annan appointed High Sheriff for Co. Fermanagh
item.description: Alison Annan has been appointed High Sheriff for County Fermanagh for 2026, bringing with her a lifetime of dedication to public service and community wellbeing. She is well known throughout the county for her charity involvement and helping others.

item.title: Genetics, community and charity in focus at Redhouse Holsteins
item.description: On a brisk January day, the farming community gathered at Redhouse Holsteins, the home of David and Alan Irwin, to witness an inspiring display of genetic progress and rural solidarity.

item.title: Ongoing postal delays raise concern despite record fines for Royal Mail
item.description: Persistent delays to postal deliveries across Fermanagh continue to cause concern for residents and public representatives, despite assurances from regulator Ofcom and repeated financial penalties imposed on Royal Mail.

item.title: Ministers acknowledge safety concerns on Derrylin Road
item.description: Serious concerns remain over the safety of the A509 Derrylin Road, despite repeated correspondence between Fermanagh and Omagh District Council and the Department for Infrastructure following recent fatal collisions.

item.title: Uncertainty remains over staffing and services at new Lisnaskea Health Centre
item.description: Uncertainty continues to surround the staffing and service provision of the new Lisnaskea Health Centre, despite repeated requests from Fermanagh and Omagh District Council for clarity from the Department of Health (DoH).

item.title: Infrastructure Minister appoints Clogher politician to Drainage Council
item.description: Infrastructure Minister, Liz Kimmins has appointed Clogher Valley councillor, Mark Robinson, to serve as a Non-Executive Councillor Member on the Drainage Council.

item.title: Who are SOAS, and why does their campaign matter?
item.description: Save Our Acute Services (SOAS) is a community-led campaign focused on bringing about the return of Emergency General Surgery at SWAH.
